notes.title: E-Startup minor update !
notes.notes:
Hi,

Thank for all players who support me, i would like to let you know, i have a new job, currently founding a company with my partner so i'm busy and as you know E-startup was made in my freetime.

But i keep the game updating very slowly. So employees vacation was fixed and i improve the size of walkable area for employees. I increased by 25% revenu from contract. Contract who offer 0$ was fixed too.

If you have small suggestions, let me know.

Have a good day !

notes.title: E-Startup 0.5.0 Big Update, Months of work, prices changes.
notes.notes:
Hi all 

I'm working on the game to add new features to improve the game quality and it's a lot of work and i planned to get few month and improve all features, improve UI, optimize, clean. Change everything.

You will not have update like usual but isn't good to have small update each week and never have a stable version, lose savegame and others problems. Now the game is going to grow up and with the school and my work i can"t stay alone so the price will up. Fund will allow me to paid people who help me ( Freelance, sound designer, ... ) and have a speeder and better work. If the price is too much for you, please wait next releases.

I say again that i don't have only the game in my work so please be patient and thank you for support the game.

If you have suggestions for the next versions, please write a post.

notes.title: Next major update and price increase
notes.notes:
I announce that the price of the game will be 4.99 $ to participate in the financing of the new team, its allows us to add more content faster and that the developer focuses only on the code! By the end of the month or early June it is planned:



- Stock management with a warehouse which brings a resource limit.

- Automatic backup at midnight

- A new stock exchange system that will buy shares and also invest in companies and get daily income

- The player must associate a worker to a machine (logic)

- Addition of raw materials and goods

- There will be new companies for contracts

- New 3D objects such as billiards, printer, pillow heap, aquarium, plants, storage shelf and more!

- There will also be a new interface for the stock market and the purchase catalog will be improved

- The options menu will be modified to add more settings

- Corrections of spelling errors and addition of languages

notes.title: Patch 07/05/2018 | Thank for your support

The update is 60mb because i started to see how improve the building system so i had to change the code and i fixed some bugs for the new players.

The game is going to be more stable, thank you for you support !
